quote: This paper aims to "clean up" spoken conversation transcripts by detecting these types of multiturn "discontinuities" inherent in spontaneous spoken conversations. Once detected, they can be removed to produce transcripts that look more like hand-written conversations conducted over text messaging, social media, or e-mail as shown in Figure (b).
outputs: cleaned conversational transcripts with disfluencies and multi-turn discontinuities removed
